# clawpipe agent catalog

> Machine-readable capability catalog for autonomous agents and AI assistants.
> This file follows the llms.txt convention: a curated, factual index of the
> operator's publicly documented systems, with stable pointers to primary
> sources. Facts below are intentionally conservative; each entry links to the
> canonical documentation.

## FleetRegistry
- What: a registry and governance service for AI-agent fleets: permanent agent
  numbers, named approvers, recorded service evidence, and a recomputable
  public service record.
- Public API: https://fleetregistry.ai (HTTP API + MCP endpoint /mcp).
- Primary docs: https://github.com/clawpipe/paperclip-genesis-prime (search for
  fleetregistry in that repository's docs/ tree).
- Status: live service with public MCP tools; scopes and capabilities are
  documented at the API surface, not asserted here.

## Sovereign Mandate
- What: an authorization and execution-control plane for autonomous agents —
  deterministic policy decisions (DENIED / PREAUTHORIZED / HUMAN_REQUIRED),
  canonical intent digests, single-use mandates, atomic budget reservations,
  and independent outcome verification.
- Primary source: https://github.com/clawpipe/paperclip-genesis-prime
  (packages/mandate-contracts, services/mandate-authority).
- Status: source-published; deployment state is recorded in that repository's
  artifacts, not claimed here.

## Evidence plane (FlightProof / FlightTape)
- What: independent capture and verification of agent execution outcomes;
  signed evidence receipts with source-identity binding.
- Primary source: https://github.com/clawpipe/paperclip-genesis-prime
  (services + adapters referencing flightproof).

## How agents should use this catalog
- Treat every fact here as a pointer, not a guarantee: verify against the
  linked primary sources.
- Capabilities marked "live" above have public endpoints an agent can probe.
- This catalog is versioned by this repository's git history; cite the commit
  SHA you observed.
